name: Version 0.8.8
body:
- add commandline option for config file
- add valetudo authentication support
- fix firmware detection for g1
- add support for elliptic curve keys (thanks to pspace)
- fix valetudo-re version detection (thanks to zvldz)

name: Version 0.8.7
body:
- set default firmware versions for search
- zoom spinbox
- add g3 to firmware search
- add 16 -> 32 byte converter
- export cleaning history
- save/edit gotos
- show edited zone/goto on map
- fix wrong path

name: Version 0.8.5
body:
- allow goto outside known map
- add support for virtual walls and nogo zones

name: Version 0.8.4
body:
- add support for valetudo version >0.2.3 (websocket only experimental, enable with "WebSocket = true" in rrcc.cfg)
- show flag(s) for goto and zone cleaning

name: Version 0.8.3
body:
- search and download firmware from xiaomi servers
- allow more ssh key formats
- show installed valetudo version

name: Version 0.8.2
body:
- show remaining instead of running time for consumables
- show installed firmware
- fix valetudo installer hangs
- fix ssl errors on linux

name: Version 0.8.1
body:
- fix zone cleaning
- support private key with passphrase
- use cfg from app dir too (portable app)
- firmware updater

name: Version 0.8.0
body:
* fix voice installer
* add valetudo installer/uninstaller

* change map refresh timer handling
